notes.title: Demo Update: New Challenges in Broken Scary Skeleton
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pS0gbQ0RorM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, Steam community!

We are pleased to present you the demo update of Broken Scary Skeleton, which brings a number of exciting innovations.

Now you can upgrade your characters after each wave, which makes the game even more dynamic and challenging. But be careful: your opponents will also become stronger regardless of your leveling!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/ab35630d52a49a33a0db39a1ab5829312b798f42.png


 New skills for each character are now available for selection after each wave, which opens up new strategic opportunities.
 We also changed the interface and effects to make the game look even more attractive.
 The character balance has been revised to ensure a more equal and interesting battle.
 The conditions for changing waves have also been updated, which adds unpredictability to the game.
 Added a new character, which awaits you in the updated demo version.
 Fixed some bugs and bugs to make your gaming experience even smoother.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/f952a6df360372d64893252081ff4f2ba1a7bef0.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/33bbf44d9d130d998fa395ae00a52c18a1419e19.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/811237ce8222e630d6b05720229c93313e9e9854.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540422/28b69fd9e5f812625283b72d0f42208a85eb42a6.gif

Join us and check out all these innovations for yourself. 

We are waiting for your feedback and comments!

Have a happy game!
